11677201.name: Cloak of Belated Death
11677201.description: Santove, a mighty adventurer, was more excelled at fleeing than claiming victory.

uniquePerk.name: Santove's Persistence
uniquePerk.description: Increases Crit Rate by 3.0% if no damage is taken for 5 sec during combat.

11677203.name: Vanguard Cloak
11677203.description: The finest warriors in the Frontier are bestowed with Vanguard cloaks. These cloaks have become both their pride and a symbol of honor.

uniquePerk.name: Vanguard's Mobility
uniquePerk.description: If no damage is taken for 5 seconds, increases Movement Speed by 15.0% for 5.0 sec. (Cooldown: 20 sec)

11677204.name: Ancestral Cloak
11677204.description: Legendary armor that can no longer be crafted.

uniquePerk.name: Ancestral Endurance
uniquePerk.description: Upon being hit, increases Damage Reduction by 12.0% for 10.0 sec. (Cooldown: 30 sec)

11677205.name: Frontier Cloak
11677205.description: The Frontier's Creed: We protect our comrades, united by the spirit of humanity.

uniquePerk.name: Frontier's Efficiency
uniquePerk.description: Upon switching weapons, reduces the cooldown of all skills by 20 sec. (Cooldown: 10 sec)

11677206.name: Academy Cloak
11677206.description: An item from a long-lost academy, now reduced to ashes. Once a symbol of great honor among scholars, it is now little more than a decorative cloak.

uniquePerk.name: Unpredictable Brilliance
uniquePerk.description: Upon attacking, grants a 2% chance to increase Attack by 20.0% for 5.0 sec. (Cooldown: 60 sec)
